params.prompt:
Image 1 is the FIXTURE AND STYLE BIBLE: the same keyboard and wooden desk top, in the same drawing style, line weight, paper colour and palette. Do NOT copy its camera or framing — this is one corner of that keyboard seen from very close. Image 2 is the CHARACTER whose hand this is: a young man with fair skin and a navy T-shirt; use it only for the look of his hand.

CAMERA: an extreme close-up, low and from the front, looking slightly down across the right-hand end of the keyboard. In the centre of the frame, on the keyboard, is ONE big key, three times the size of the ordinary keys around it, a plain rounded rectangle with the word SHIP hand-lettered in graphite capitals across its face. The ordinary keys around it are small blank rectangles. An adult right hand enters from the lower right of the frame: the index finger is extended and rests lightly on the keyboard beside the SHIP key, touching the keys next to it, hovering just off the big key itself; the other fingers are curled back. The key is NOT pressed: it stands at its full height like the others. The wooden desk top shows along the top of the frame. Nothing else is in frame.

The hand is drawn simply and correctly: one hand, five fingers, the index finger extended. Light coloured-pencil skin wash.

Warm cream drawing paper throughout, a pale putty cream, never white and never yellow. The floor is the same cream a half-step darker. Walls and floor are flat, quiet, and low-contrast — the room is a pale ground, and colour lives only on small props. Graphite line and cross-hatch shadow carry all the form. Overall value stays high-key and even: no dark corners, no pooled shadow, no colour cast, no vignette, no dramatic lighting.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, visible construction lines, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash on props only, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no photographic lighting, no 3D. The only text anywhere in the picture is the word SHIP on the big key.
